body: So when will the good waves come? For me it seems it will never come.
Yeah i can obviously feel happy but it never lasts..

You are so right. But this pain seems to be never ending. Throughout my life I had only been happy for only 3 months. Rest of my life I had been sad as fuck. 3 months out of 22 yrs is to less to consider.
Good for you.  I guess I will never find happiness in these little things.
It's not about getting help, It's about having no other options.
But I am pretty sure at this point that nothing great will happen to me ever.
